notes.title: Let's play Dolmenjord - Vilking Islands!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937677/42c6d9a83597a15644ec5ec1dc89ad3c7411956e.png[/img]

Dolmenjord is a game inspired by Norse mythology, where Vikings need help to organize their buildings and villages and thus solve the puzzles and dominate new lands.

It is available now!

Great for Nordic culture fans who love to be challenged with logic puzzles.

Set up each village according to the rules:
- Place all the available houses and walkway pieces.
- Every house must face the walkway.
-  The completed walkway must give access to the port.

The puzzles are simple in the early islands, but it gets challenging as you advance in the exploration. If you prefer a more relaxing journey, that's fine!
Whenever you want, you can enable the Casual Mode.

notes.title: Island Farmer is available now!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/344c38eb4bc78bc1ddf48368fa86f55d7ba57f8f.jpg[/img]

Farms are set up in islands over calm and clear water.
In this tiny fantasy experience, that is easy to do and very relaxing, just like a 3D jigsaw puzzle.

Swap the blocks to recreate the desired island and it will compose the archipelago.

There is no time limit, logic challenges, or resources to manage, so you can calmly just focus on the core mechanics while listening to a soothing soundtrack.
[list]
[*] Click on two blocks to swap them,
[*] Turn the camera around the island;
[*] Zoom in and out to see details or the big picture;
[*] Preview the expected arrangement.
[/list]
As you progress building the islands, see your archipelago expand and evolve in the background.
With clear skies, fresh air, and crystal clear water, among animals and listening to the sounds of nature.


Play it now!

notes.title: Update - Brand new levels for Mini Words!
notes.content:
We are updating Mini Words with brand new extra levels! 

This expansion is free to everyone who has purchased it. After downloading the update, they will be unlocked to everyone who completes the previous available levels - A to P. 

All new levels (from Q to Z) contain a subset of the 721 previously discovered words - the most used words in English conversation.

The update also contains some visual adjustments and spelling reviews, as well as an option to restore game progress that could have been reset for some players (in Options menu).

This is to thank you all who have played and enjoyed Mini Words!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35968398/c935a5df860d3c29cd838a145c41f1460e58ea56.png[/img]

And also to inform you about our game released a few weeks ago! 
That's "Mini Words: Top Movies", where you will test your knowledge about the highest-grossing films of all time.

notes.title: MIni Words update
Mini Words is available now!
notes.content:
721 words. That is enough to cover 90% of conversations in English. 
Unscramble those words in Mini Words - a unique mix of puzzle, word search and hangman.

Quick facts on English language:
- 600,000+ words: English dictionary.
- 30,000 words: average vocabulary of an adult educated in English.
- 2800 words: cover 90% of texts and conversations for an ESL student.
- 721 words: enough to cover 90% of conversations. Do you know them?

Discover the most used words in English in Mini Words, a unique mix of puzzle, word search and hangman, in a minimalist and relaxing environment, no distractions.
Unscramble them using all letters on the board, without repeating or crossing paths.

- Simple to start: boards are small and words are easily recognized. But it won’t be easy to obtain all master achievements (in “no tips” mode!).
- Ones learning English can practice vocabulary. Have all those classes been worth it?
- But ones mastering the language have also the challenge to solve the puzzles. More advanced levels will test the skills of attention and logic problems solving.
-  300+ levels and 700+ words.

Play it now on Steam!
